metadata.description: Verified, version-matched Agent Skills for .NET and AI-agent development. Every API claim is checked against the real assemblies or SDKs it describes.

plugins.name: agent-skills
plugins.description: The whole catalog as one plugin: msaf-architect, spectre-console, microsoft-extensions-ai, mcp-sdk, maui-engineer, reviewers. Install one skill instead by picking it from the list below.

plugins.name: spectre-console
plugins.description: Verified guidance for rich .NET terminal UIs with Spectre.Console: tables, panels, trees, markup & color, live displays (Status/Progress/Live), and interactive prompts - plus terminal-gating for CI/non-tty safety.

plugins.name: mcp-sdk
plugins.description: Verified, version-matched guidance for building against the MCP SDKs in C#, TypeScript, and Python: tools, transports, and a minimal server -- each verified against its own pinned SDK.

plugins.name: reviewers
plugins.description: Configurable multi-lens review panel for any artifact - code, docs, specs, migrations, infrastructure.
